info.title: Spend Documents
info.description: Allows certified vendors to submit compliant receipts and compliance documents to the SAP Concur platform on behalf of users. The workflow involves posting a display version of the receipt with the required data, then uploading the compliance document via PUT. Suited for certified receipt providers and tax compliance integrations.

x-sap-shortText: Ingests and retrieves compliance receipts and spend documents
